sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: While Unstable, maintaining an Adaptation costs 1 additional Stamina at upkeep. Efficient Transformation does not reduce this additional cost.

sections.label: DURATION
sections.html: During your Turn, you may burn 2 Action dice to end Unstable. It also ends when you complete a Turn without maintaining an Adaptation or when the Encounter ends. Unstable does not itself prevent Gestalt Actions or force an immediate reversion.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
